shortDescription: MEXICO CITY, Sept 24 (Reuters) - Mexico's economy grew 0.8 percent in July from June and expanded 3.4 percent from July of 2025, the national statistics agency said on Thursday.((Mexico City newsroom, +52 55 5282-7153, mexicocity.newsroom@reuters.com))
